title: fence a missing --record-file / --include from its real parent path
evidence: Owner ruling 2026-11-13 on PR 1491 (US-40 AC18). Repro: d/link points to e/sub; run --record --record-file d/link/../rec.json with the record missing. The run reads e/rec.json, but the fence climbs from d, so --out e/rec.json is neither fenced nor overlapping: the run writes its placeholder there and stops incomplete. Fix options: climb from the unresolved dirname, or fence at the parent's real path. Owner prefers the real parent path: one rule for both classes. tools/codex-review-out.mjs fenced()
